title: Natural localized coefficient comparison on K-flat complexes
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in universe u, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an E=A tensor_R B algebra structure on C. Assume derived categories for R-, A-, and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex satisfying K-flatness [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], N any C-module cochain complex, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map, where F is termwise scalar extension along A to E to C. Assume C flat over E, and fix i in Z. Let K be the full category of K-flat A-complexes, W_K its morphisms which are quasi-isomorphisms, and m(U)=baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U tensor_A Q) C the canonical universal model [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Define T:K to Mod(C) by T(U)=H^i(F(U) tensor_C N). There exist S:K to Mod(C), a natural transformation eta:S to T, and for each U an isomorphism e:C tensor_E m(U).cohomology(i) to S(U), such that S inverts W_K and e.hom followed by eta_U equals m(U).localizedComparison(i) followed by H^i(mu_F(U,Q) inverse followed by identity of F(U) tensor t), as in [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property]. This assertion constructs a natural transformation only on K-flat complexes and for canonical models; it makes no target inversion or derived descent assertion.

source.place: Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change; Tag 065Y, construction of equation-comparison-map (065Z); Tag 0BYJ, functorial associativity; perfect.tex equation-bc (0DJ7). Official Stacks pages read online because the remote clone omits these source files.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-base-tensor-cohomology-functor in degree i. It supplies an E-valued cohomology functor H, its ordinary comparison sigma, canonical model isomorphisms e, and inversion of all quasi-isomorphisms.

Construct the ordinary A-to-E-to-C coefficient chain natural transformation by transposing the A-to-C scalar-extension unit through the A-to-E adjunction and the restriction-composition isomorphism. Its generator equation is e tensor p maps to image(e) tensor p. Take homology and the exact restriction homology identification; compose with sigma and transpose through the E-to-C adjunction to obtain rho:H extended to C to homology of C extension. Naturality is adjunction naturality. On each canonical model its coefficient chain map equals ordinaryToLocalized by the generator equations. The adjunction naturality, sigma component equation and localized_eq prove that extending e then applying rho equals localizedComparison.

Precompose the source and rho by inclusion of K-flat complexes followed by tensorRight Q. The acyclic-tensor hypothesis on Q yields categorical K-flatness through the homotopy acyclic criterion and braiding. Thus tensorRight Q preserves quasi-isomorphisms. H inverts them, and scalar extension to C preserves the resulting isomorphisms, proving source inversion.

The inverse monoidal tensorator of C-extension, followed by identity tensor t, forms a chain natural transformation in U. Its naturality is the oplax tensorator naturality equation followed by whisker_exchange. Take homology and compose it with precomposed rho to obtain eta. Extend e(U tensor Q) to C. Associativity and the component equation for rho give the claimed displayed equality. No flatness of C is used in this construction; the existing hypothesis is retained unchanged.
